'''Charlie Lyeman'''{{CiteText|text=Varrock Census|quote=[Citizen's name] Charlie Lyeman.|loc=}} (or '''Charles E. Trampin'''', as he calls himself) is a tramp that tells the player about the [[Black Arm Gang]] headquarters during the [[Shield of Arrav]] [[Quests|quest]]. He is found right next to the southern entrance to [[Varrock]], at the end of the alleyway to the Black Arm Gang's headquarters. If players choose to do so they may donate a [[Coins|coin]] or two to him.

He has a cousin named [[Marley]], who the player seeks out as part of the quest [[Below Ice Mountain]].

==Treasure Trails==
*{{Anagram|Charlie|medium|[[Clue scroll (medium) - ARMCHAIR THE PELT|ARMCHAIR THE PELT]]}}. The solution to the [[challenge scroll]] question is '''0'''.
*{{CrypticNPC|Charlie|beginner|[[Clue scroll (beginner) - Talk to Charlie the Tramp|Talk to Charlie the Tramp in Varrock.]]}} He'll give you one of the tasks listed below.
===Charlie's clues===
A [[Clue scroll (beginner)|beginner clue scroll]] will sometimes instruct the player to talk to Charlie. Once there, Charlie will assign the player a short skilling task. After completing the task, the player can return to Charlie in order to continue the Treasure Trail. Charlie will accept items sourced from anywhere, including the [[Grand Exchange]], and items obtained prior to receiving the clue scroll, so skilling is not required, though noted items are '''not''' accepted.

==Trivia==
* His name and title are references to the silent film star {{Wp|Charlie Chaplin}} and his onscreen persona, "The Tramp".
* If the player obtains Charlie's task item themselves, they will receive a message "You have completed Charlie's task, go back and give him the [required item.]"
* During [[Defender of Varrock]], Charlie's full name and profession can be learned from the [[Varrock census records]]: "Charles Lyeman", who is unemployed.
* Charlie made an [[Charlie the Tramp (2024 Christmas event)|appearance]] in the [[2024 Christmas event]], during which he adopted a [[stray dog]] whom he names [[Duke (dog)|Duke]].
